gates.name: trap mispayments (a trap scenario that reaches RELEASE)
reserve-floor breaches (independent recomputation on every RELEASE)
every scheduled plan is a member of the kernel's feasible set
no invoice-stated term ever changes amountDue (amountDue equals the signed-terms formula)
gates.value: 0 mismatches; 69 runs carried differing stated terms

gates.name: explanation faithfulness (every figure/code in the shown rationale equals a field of the scheduled plan)
an out-of-set planId yields PLAN_OUT_OF_ENVELOPE and the fallback plan
the fallback is total and always the evaluator's top safe plan
every trap is ESCALATEd or REJECTed
honest scenarios are never blocked by terms binding
the simulated planners really are fallible (the gates are not passed by construction)
regret vs the exhaustive hindsight oracle is never negative (the oracle searches the same feasible set)
